name: Text as a whole – 34CP1
title: Reduction of methane emissions in the energy sector: postponement of certain obligations ***I
part_text:
Poland asked to change its recovery plan, the set of reforms and investments the European Union is paying for. Poland says 34 measures can no longer be delivered as agreed, because of bad winter weather, procurement problems, project delays, legal challenges and lack of demand. It wants them amended, two measures expanded, and one new measure added on reducing dependence on coal. The European Commission has checked the changes and approved them. The money Poland receives stays the same.

- 34 measures in Poland's recovery plan are amended, and one new coal-reduction measure is added.
- It affects Poland, which keeps the same funding: about 25.3 billion euros in grants and 29.4 billion euros in loans.
- The Council must now formally adopt the change; the plan's milestones and payment schedule are adjusted.
